description: A militarized JP8/diesel auxiliary power unit (APU).  Switch it on and it burns fuel from the vehicle's tanks to trickle-charge the battery bank - the practical way to keep a power-hungry directed-energy weapon fed in the field.  The solar panels and the engine's alternator also feed the batteries on their own; the APU is the heavy lifter when the sun won't cut it.
//: BIZARRE FIELD NAMES (lifted from TLG's working portable generator, ap_portable_generator): 'epower' = how fast fuel is converted to grid power; 'power' = fuel efficiency (ratio of fuel mL to battery charges output). fuel_type 'diesel' burns the GMV's jp8 (diesel-family parts accept jp8, same as its engine).
